description: Get one saved build by ID. Returns the full spec without truncation. The opaque web uploader session snapshot webState is also included by default; pass include: ["-webState"] to omit it. Update spec for content changes and do not reconstruct webState. Other metadata is trimmed for display.

include.description: The web uploader session snapshot is included by default. Use -webState to omit it; webState remains accepted.

name: ads_get_build
title: Get Saved Build
